sentences.text: In any linear circuit containing multiple independent sources, the voltage or current through any element is the algebraic sum of the responses caused by each source acting alone.
To turn off a voltage source, replace it with a short circuit (0 Volts, a solid wire).
To turn off a current source, replace it with an open circuit (0 Amperes, a broken wire).
Calculate the output for each source individually, then add the partial results together.
